findings.title: MCP source resume pins omit operator policy that changes effect and validation semantics
findings.recommendation: Hash a canonical payload containing config.describe plus every policy setting consumed by build_server, at minimum normalized read_only_tools and database options, and add a resume test that changes each policy while keeping the catalog snapshot unchanged.

findings.title: The sealed registry accepts duplicate source IDs although host dispatch has one implementation slot per ID
findings.recommendation: Reject duplicate source.source_id values in Registry.build before build_registry and add one focused host/registry test.

findings.title: MCP server and descriptor aggregation has no global resource bound
findings.recommendation: Add a simple aggregate server and descriptor admission limit before catalog materialization, and reject the complete configuration when it exceeds that limit.

findings.title: Caller-supplied MCP sources may omit the source provenance map
findings.recommendation: Decide whether source provenance is mandatory for every MCP source; if so require an exact valid digest map keyed by every catalog server, otherwise document catalog-only mode.

findings.title: Browser governance is an injected adapter seam with no sealed-catalog reachability
findings.recommendation: Keep the public contract explicit that this is an injected adapter seam, or add deliberate browser source registration only when an approved connector exists; add a reachability test for the chosen state.
